cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. May I put one extra chair in the hall?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Excellent. It's for the chair of my new tenants' committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I approved furniture, not a committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then welcome to our first agenda item: what your chair authorises.

mechanism: Copy a neighbor's extra chair as an official meeting position, secure permission for it, then widen furniture approval into hosting a committee.
confusable: Not just a chair pun: B2 must reveal why the copied chair actually existed and A must deny confusion while expanding the granted permission.
comparison: Hall furniture and committee duties differ from tea invitations becoming accommodation.
seedUse: Retains extra chair, tenants committee and approval scope; new wet-chair reason makes imitation explicit.
